title: Former Taiwan leader Tsai to visit Czech Republic, other European destinations, drawing China's ire
description: Former Taiwan leader Tsai Ing-wen is to visit Czech Republic, and other European destinations, drawing China’s ire.

title: Mystery Amidst Waves: Alleged Sinking of China's Hybrid Submarine
description: Western media has speculated on the sinking of a Chinese Type 041 Zhou class submarine prototype. Satellite imagery showed salvage operations, but China remains silent. Questions arose about the submarine's nuclear capabilities, while Pentagon sources hinted at concealed issues within the PLA's defense industry.

title: Chinese travelers return to Kinmen, a Taiwan island off mainland China
description: Tourism has slowly started to resume on Kinmen, a remote Taiwanese island 1.8 miles from China that once thrived on visitors from the mainland.

title: ‘Impossible’ for Communist China to be our motherland as we’re older, Taiwan’s president says
description: It is “absolutely impossible” for the People’s Republic of China to become Taiwan’s motherland because the island’s government is older, Taiwan’s president said ahead of the island’s national day celebrations.

title: China likely to launch military drills around Taiwan after president's national speech, sources say
description: Mr Lai will deliver a key speech on Oct 10. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: China's Military Drills Loom Over Taiwan's National Day
description: China may conduct military drills near Taiwan, using President Lai Ching-te's national day speech as a pretext. Previously, China launched similar drills, termed 'Joint Sword - 2024A', following Lai's inauguration. Taiwan officials expect further exercises, potentially named 'Joint Sword - 2024B', amidst ongoing geopolitical tensions.

title: Tsai Ing-wen's Diplomatic Mission: Navigating Tensions with China on European Visit
description: Former Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen plans to visit the Czech Republic, France, and Belgium this month, marking a sensitive diplomatic journey amidst heightened tensions with China. Her visit aims to strengthen Taiwan's ties with Europe, addressing geopolitical challenges and Beijing's increasing military posturing.

title: Former Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen Sets Eyes on Europe with Prague Visit
description: Former Taiwan president Tsai Ing-wen will visit the Czech Republic, a move highlighting her ongoing role in strengthening Taiwan's ties with Europe despite China's disapproval. Her visit includes a speech at Forum 2000 and meetings with European leaders amid tense China-Taiwan relations.

title: Mainland China not the motherland, says Taiwan’s president, because our republic is older
description: Lai Ching-te argues the reverse may be true because the Republic of China – the mantle that nationalists carried with them to Taiwan – predates the communist People’s Republic

title: 'Impossible' for People's Republic of China to be our motherland, Taiwan president says
description: Lai, who took office in May, is condemned by Beijing as a "separatist."
